Indwe is a personal and business insurance broker that describes itself as a leading specialist in insurance and financial needs. Its Polokwane Central office at 17 Schoeman Street arranges personal and business cover, along with risk-management advice for motor, household, commercial and corporate insurance. Clients can choose and manage their personal cover through the Indwe app or its web version.

Through its partner Indwe BlueStar, the group also provides life insurance, investment, healthcare, estate planning and bond advice, and the partner is an authorised financial services provider. The firm says its advice is holistic and backed by years of experience, which makes it a good fit for households and businesses that want one adviser to look at their insurance, savings and retirement together.

Iveco Polokwane is an authorised Iveco dealership in Nirvana, operated by the BB group, selling commercial vehicles alongside a workshop staffed by qualified artisans for mechanical repairs. The dealership runs separate departments for new sales, used vehicles and parts, along with a service and parts team, so trucks and vans can be bought, serviced and repaired in one place.

Special offers and vehicle finance are promoted on the dealership's site, and the workshop has its own manager. Operators who depend on commercial vehicles for their business can use the dealership for sales, aftersales and parts support. It is at Ext 1, Tagore Street in Nirvana, Polokwane.

JAC Polokwane is the official reseller of JAC products in Polokwane, and it specialises in double-cab bakkies and commercial vehicles. The range on offer includes the T9, T8 and T6 double and single cabs, the X200 single and double cabs and the X200 EV, along with JAC trucks and an N75 6-tonne chassis cab and dropside.

Buyers can arrange finance for business or personal purchases, and the dealership runs a service department for JAC owners. The brand's emergency roadside assistance line is also advertised on the site, and its news section covers developments such as the ABS upgrade on the X200 and record export sales. The dealership at 7A Grobler Street in Polokwane Central suits private buyers who want a bakkie and businesses that need light commercial vehicles for their work.

Limpopo Guest Manor is a guest property at 48 Devenish Street in Hospital Park, with a restaurant, a bar, a garden and a terrace for guests to use. Its family rooms have air conditioning and private bathrooms, and each room includes a work desk, a TV and an electric kettle, with free Wi-Fi and free private parking on site.

Guests on the booking platform praise the attentive staff, the breakfast and the comfortable beds, and the property sits about 11 km from Polokwane International Airport. Its listing carries a score of 7.4 from 335 reviews, with location rated highly by guests, which makes it a practical stay for business travellers and families visiting Polokwane.

M.E. Makgato Secondary School is a public secondary school at Stand 625 in Zone 4, Seshego, serving the Seshego urban area of Limpopo. It is a no-fee school classified as Quintile 3, a category for a community with moderate socio-economic status, and it receives government funding per learner to cover running costs and learning resources.

Registration for the following academic year typically runs between April and October, and parents or guardians need to submit documents such as birth certificates and immunisation cards, with extra papers required for non-South African citizens. Provincial Learner Admissions Coordinators can guide families through the process. Uniform rules are set by the school governing body, which makes the school a practical choice for families in Seshego Zone 4 who want a no-fee secondary school close to home.

The company says it has delivered projects on time and offers a free consultation before a project starts, which suits organisations that want a single provider for software and on-site network work. The office is at 342 Zone F in Lebowakgomo.

Centurion Mag Repairs specialises in the repair and refurbishment of alloy wheel rims and mags, and it also does welding and mag repair work from its Annadale workshop in Polokwane. Services include custom colour changes, PCD conversions and wheel customisation, with secondhand rims and tyres also available.

The workshop fits and balances every wheel on site, and it can provide loan rims for most vehicles on request. Rims can be collected and delivered to clients across Limpopo and anywhere in Southern Africa, which makes it a useful option for drivers who want a damaged set restored or a new look for their car. The shop is on Pietersburg Street in Annadale.
